name of work: Development and operation of Loyalty Management Platform for Servo
tender no: Tender Ref.: MnC/LUB-13/PT-33/26-27, GeM Bid ID: GEM/2026/B/7713160
ato_criteria: Financial turnover in any of the last three preceding financial years. More than or equal to Rs. 10 Z – 25 marks; More than or equal to Rs. 8 Z and < Rs. 10 Z – 20 marks; More than or equal to Rs. 6 Z and < Rs. 8 Z – 15 marks; More than or equal to Rs. 4 Z and < Rs. 6 Z – 10 marks; Less than Rs. 4 Z – 0 marks.
similar_work_definition: Similar work shall mean the implementation or management or operation of a loyalty or reward or incentive or promotional program through an IT/Digital/Online platform with an integrated redemption facility in the form of vouchers or coupons or card or direct cash transfer via NEFT/RTGS/UPI/e-Wallet. Note: Redemption or reward amounts settled by the vendor to beneficiaries or users shall be excluded from the value of similar work orders.
